HR.label: Heart Rate
HR.description: Tachycardia (>90 bpm) is a core SIRS criterion reflecting autonomic stress in infection.

Resp.label: Respiration Rate
Resp.description: Tachypnea (>20 breaths/min) indicates respiratory compensation for metabolic acidosis or pulmonary injury.

Temp.label: Body Temperature
Temp.description: Hyperthermia (>38.0°C) or hypothermia (<36.0°C) indicates dysregulated host immune response.

MAP.label: Mean Arterial Pressure
MAP.description: MAP < 65 mmHg is a critical septic shock criterion indicating hypoperfusion.

O2Sat.label: Oxygen Saturation (SpO2)
O2Sat.description: Peripheral arterial oxygen saturation, decreases with respiratory failure and hypoxia.

SBP.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
SBP.description: Systolic pressure; hypotension (SBP < 90 mmHg) is a key qSOFA trigger.

WBC.label: White Blood Cell Count
WBC.description: Leukocytosis (>12) or leukopenia (<4) reflects active systemic inflammatory mobilization.

Lactate.label: Serum Lactate
Lactate.description: Elevated lactate (>2.0 mmol/L) marks tissue hypoperfusion and anaerobic glycolysis in sepsis.

Creatinine.label: Serum Creatinine
Creatinine.description: Acute elevation signifies renal dysfunction and contributes to SOFA score assessment.

Platelets.label: Platelet Count
Platelets.description: Thrombocytopenia (<150) indicates consumption coagulopathy or septic microangiopathy.

Glucose.label: Blood Glucose
Glucose.description: Stress-induced hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia in severe septic states.

BUN.label: Blood Urea Nitrogen
BUN.description: Nitrogenous waste accumulation marking prerenal azotemia and dehydration.

pH.label: Arterial Blood pH
pH.description: Acid-base equilibrium; acidemia (pH < 7.35) marks metabolic acidosis in septic shock.

Age.label: Patient Age
Age.description: Advanced age (>65) substantially increases susceptibility and mortality risk for sepsis.

ICULOS.label: ICU Length of Stay
ICULOS.description: Cumulative hours in ICU; prolonged stays elevate risk of hospital-acquired septic events.

Gender.label: Biological Sex
Gender.description: Biological sex indicator for demographic adjustment.
